properties.description:
Identifies newly reported Advert results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.
properties.name: Netcraft Advert - High risk result

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: New advert result {{ResultUuid}} from {{AdvertiserName}} reported risk {{RiskCategory}}.

properties.query:
NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where ChangeType == "new"
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| where RiskCategory in ("highest", "high")
| extend Url = DisplayUrl
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    ResultUuid,
    Subject,
    Platform,
    AdvertiserName,
    AdvertiserId,
    AdvertTitle,
    DisplayUrl,
    Url,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType
